verdict.rationale: Feitian docs explicitly cover FIDO2 sk-ssh style OpenSSH usage (including GitHub and Linux server connections) and PIV smart-card logon/digital signature via SK Manager, supporting the hardware-backed SSH story. However, there's no explicit mention of OpenPGP support, no independent/hands-on corroboration of touch-required SSH workflows, and no detail on sk-ssh key generation specifics (e.g. ssh-keygen -t ed25519-sk flows). Missing for 10: OpenPGP applet/card support, independent verification of touch-to-authenticate SSH flow, detailed sk-ssh setup documentation beyond a single guide link.
